name: Robust Intelligence
what_it_does: Enterprise platform for AI risk: pre-deployment model validation, continuous monitoring, and runtime AI firewall. Covers both predictive ML and generative AI workloads with reporting designed for risk and compliance functions.
what_it_doesnt_do: Enterprise pricing and procurement timeline. Some features overlap with what mature in-house teams can build with open source; the value is the integration, support, and reporting, not novel algorithms.
best_for: Large regulated enterprises wanting a single vendor across pre-deployment, monitoring, and runtime
Teams without an in-house AI security platform team
